nodes.label: Hand-rolled Gaussian Elimination (partial pivoting, no dependencies)
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting, run on a full dense copy of K per load step (no factorization reuse across load steps) — chosen to keep the solver dependency-free, not for performance.
nodes.norm_label: hand-rolled gaussian elimination (partial pivoting, no dependencies)

nodes.label: Load Stepping (ramp applied loads 0 to full over N steps)
nodes.rationale: Re-solves the full system from scratch each load step (fresh copy of k_orig, no incremental/tangent update) because this is a linear-elastic solver, not path-dependent — intentional simplicity, not an oversight to 'fix' with caching unless asked.
nodes.norm_label: load stepping (ramp applied loads 0 to full over n steps)
